content.comment_body: Hi, I suspect I'm overlooking something simple, but after I disconnect my PC from the module ([article_no]) following a program download, a network error message keeps appearing. This error doesn't clear through the diagnostics menu.
Hello, you can disable the network error message in the Diagnostics Menu. More details are available in the [product_name] manual, page 128. Regards, [user_name]
Alright, I've already done this but was concerned it might only be hiding a real problem.
A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread with the subject 'diagnostic message area length error when writing'. Best regards, CS Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that a network error message repeatedly appears on the module after disconnecting the PC, even after a successful program download. This error persists until manually disabled in the diagnostics menu, causing confusion over whether it reflects a real issue or is simply informational. The lack of automated removal or clear instructions leads to uncertainty about product reliability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that disconnecting the PC after programming should not result in persistent network error messages, or at minimum, such messages should be clearly explained and easy to clear if not urgent.
